tables.usage-files.csv: source path relative to src and line coverage
tables.usage-refs.csv: one record per distinct identifier within a declaration; negative target -2-g denotes group index g
tables.usage-groups.json: arrays of candidate declaration IDs indexed by group
tables.usage-reach.csv: BFS discovery records; empty single_target_depth means requires ambiguity
tables.handoff-citations.json: Handoff lines, recognized citations and unresolved competing paths
tables.interface-witnesses.json: Forty proposition definitions, consumer/supplier/type witnesses and source application routes
tables.blackbox-paths.json: Shortest lexical paths to selected declarations
tables.blackbox-call-paths.json: Source-body paths to named arithmetic and archimedean applications
